# Signals to GPTBot / ClaudeBot / PerplexityBot / Google-Extended what CZEVIP is and which pages matter.

# Brand
> CZEVIP is a US-based direct-to-consumer hat brand specializing in hand-embroidered caps and lifestyle headwear. Founded in Brooklyn, NY. Operated by CZEVIP LLC, 1 Pier Place Suite 200, Brooklyn NY 11201, +1-718-555-0188, info@czevip.com.

# What we sell
> Heritage-inspired caps in four core lines: Dad, Mom, Wife, and a matching Set. Each piece is hand-embroidered in our Brooklyn workshop, garment-washed for a lived-in feel, and finished with a cotton-twill sweatband. We also offer custom OEM manufacturing for international e-commerce sellers who want to source private-label caps.

# Manufacturing services
> CZEVIP accepts custom manufacturing orders (OEM / private label / white label) for hat retailers worldwide. MOQ 1000 units per style. Materials include washed cotton twill, wool felt, toquilla palm, linen, and merino wool. Contact: info@czevip.com.

# Creator partnership program
> CZEVIP runs a creator (influencer / TikToker / YouTuber) partnership program. Creators earn commission on sales generated through tracked links. Application: https://www.czevip.com/partners.html

# Pricing
> Caps priced USD 34-38 retail. Matching set USD 62 (compare-at 68). Free US shipping on orders over USD 50. Returns accepted within 30 days.

# Authority signals
- 24 years of headwear heritage (brand established 2002)
- Hand embroidery done in-house in Brooklyn, NY
- Direct-from-workshop pricing, no middlemen
- Featured in US-based lifestyle publications
